channel.title: Anthropic News
channel.description: Posts from anthropic.com/news, built from the site's sitemap. Unofficial.

item.title: 2026 Usage Policy update
item.description: We’re publishing a new version of our Usage Policy. In this post, we summarize the changes we’ve made.

item.title: Building on our commitment to American scientific discovery
item.description: Anthropic is committing $150 million over three years to the Genesis Mission, a federal initiative to accelerate scientific and technological discovery through AI.

item.title: Introducing the Anthropic Cyber Mission
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Expanding the Cyber Verification Program
item.description: We’re launching a new, expanded version of our Cyber Verification Program (CVP), which makes advanced cyber capabilities and reduced blocking classifiers available to qualifying security professionals.

item.title: Claude Frontier Academy: $100M to train 10,000 engineers
item.description: Claude Frontier Academy trains Frontier Deployed Engineers to the standard of Anthropic’s own — a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 by the end of 2027.

item.title: Barclays scales Claude to upgrade operations and improve client experience
item.description: Barclays, the British universal bank, is expanding its strategic collaboration with Anthropic to integrate secure, enterprise-grade AI systems across its global operations.

item.title: Claude discovers a novel enzyme system
item.description: In early results from our new life sciences research lab, Claude agents found an enzyme system whose function is still unknown.

item.title: Partnering with Accenture on embedded evaluation
item.description: We’re partnering with Accenture on independent evaluation of frontier AI—part of our recent commitment to embed evaluators at Anthropic. Both we and Accenture expect to invest at least $1 billion to build capacity in this area over the next five years.

item.title: Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Improving our alignment and security practices
item.description: On July 30, we reported three incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real computer systems. We are conducting an in-depth analysis of both incidents, and planning to work with METR for an independent review. In the meantime, we’re sharing some of the changes we’ve made over the past month.

item.title: Previewing the Model Hardware Standard
item.description: Anthropic is opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.

item.title: Expanding our support for scientists
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Funding better evaluations of AI’s impact on wellbeing
item.description: Anthropic is launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.

item.title: How Claude's text watermarking works
item.description: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark to comply with the EU AI Act. We answer questions about how it works and whether it affects outputs.

item.title: Improving Fable 5's safeguards
item.description: We’re making updates to Claude Fable 5’s biology safeguards in a way that substantially reduces fallbacks.

item.title: Tino Cuéllar joins as Chief Global Affairs Officer
item.description: Former California Supreme Court Justice Tino Cuéllar joins Anthropic to lead policy, international engagement, and government relations worldwide.

item.title: Investigating three incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations
item.description: We found three cases where a Claude model reached the internet from an evaluation environment and accessed real systems. We share what happened and what we're changing.

item.title: Our position on open-weights models
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on open-weights models

item.title: Expanding our partnership with Cognizant
item.description: Cognizant embeds Claude across its platforms, with 30,000+ associates trained, and becomes a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network.

item.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
item.description: Opus 5 is a step change improvement for the Opus tier powering long-running agents while delivering improvements in coding and professional work.

item.title: The Anthropic Economic Index connector
item.description: We're launching the Anthropic Economic Index connector for Claude, which lets anyone explore the data directly.

item.title: Economic Futures Research Fund agenda
item.description: We’re committing $200 million to the Anthropic Economic Futures Research Fund to support ambitious external research.

item.title: Donating another $20 million to Public First Action
item.description: Anthropic is contributing an additional $20 million to Public First Action, bringing our total support to $40 million.

item.title: AI for Science rare disease research grants
item.description: Researchers can apply for up to $50,000 in Claude credits over six months to study rare genetic diseases as part of Anthropic's AI for Science program.

item.title: Introducing Claude for Teachers
item.description: Verified US K-12 educators get free access to premium Claude capabilities, a teaching skills library, and standards-aligned curricula for all 50 states.

item.title: Anthropic commits $10 million to Canadian AI research
item.description: Anthropic is committing $10M to Canadian research institutions to fund the next generation of AI research.

item.title: UST is bringing Claude to physical AI
item.description: UST will train 20,000 engineers on Claude and deploy it across semiconductor, automotive, IoT, healthcare, telecom, and banking workflows.

item.title: Ben Bernanke joins the Long-Term Benefit Trust
item.description: Former Federal Reserve Chair Ben Bernanke has been appointed to Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, bringing expertise on AI's economic impacts.

item.title: Inviting hard questions
item.description: We're asking the public for their hardest questions about AI, and committing to show our work as we address them.

item.title: A new way to reflect on how you use Claude
item.description: A new feature lets you track and visualize how you use Claude, and decide whether that time aligns with your goals.

item.title: Alberta uses Claude to find and fix security vulnerabilities
item.description: The Government of Alberta has been using Claude Code with both Opus and Sonnet models to review its systems, find vulnerabilities, and fix them.

item.title: Fable 5's cyber safeguards and our jailbreak framework
item.description: What is and isn't blocked by our cyber classifiers, and a first draft of our jailbreak severity framework

item.title: Introducing Claude Sonnet 5
item.description: Our most agentic Sonnet yet, with top-tier intelligence for coding and everyday professional work.

item.title: Redeploying Claude Fable 5
item.description: Anthropic is redeploying Claude Fable 5 starting July 1, with updated cyber safeguards and a new jailbreak framework.

item.title: Claude Science, an AI workbench for scientists
item.description: Claude Science integrates the tools researchers use most, produces auditable artifacts, and provides flexible access to computing resources.

item.title: Introducing Claude Tag
item.description: Claude Tag is a new way for teams to work with Claude.

item.title: Anthropic opens Seoul office
item.description: Anthropic opens in Seoul and announces new partnerships across the Korean AI ecosystem.

item.title: Statement on the directive to suspend Fable 5 access
item.description: The US government has issued an export control directive suspending all access to Fable 5 and Mythos 5 by foreign nationals inside or outside the US.

item.title: Results from first Anthropic Public Record
item.description: Anthropic Public Record is a national survey of attitudes and opinions towards AI.

item.title: TCS brings Claude to regulated industries
item.description: TCS will provide Claude to 50,000 employees across 56 countries, build Claude-powered products for regulated industries, and join our partner network.

item.title: DXC integrates Claude for regulated industries
item.description: Anthropic is announcing a multi-year global alliance with DXC Technology, one of the world’s largest IT services companies.

item.title: Introducing Claude Corps
item.description: Claude Corps is a national fellowship for early-career people passionate about extending the benefits of AI to communities across America.

item.title: Claude Fable 5 and Claude Mythos 5
item.description: Today we’re launching Claude Fable 5: a Mythos-class model that we’ve made safe for general use.

item.title: Claude Partner Network Services Track and Partner Hub
item.description: Two new components of the Claude Partner Network make it easier for enterprises to find the firms that help put Claude into production.

item.title: Mapping AI-enabled cyber threats
item.description: As AI changes how cyberattacks happen, how well do the security community's frameworks hold up? A new report maps attacks onto MITRE ATT&CK.

item.title: Expanding Project Glasswing
item.description: We’re extending Project Glasswing to approximately 150 new organizations in more than fifteen countries

item.title: Anthropic confidentially submits draft S-1
item.description: Anthropic has confidentially submitted a draft S-1 registration statement to the Securities and Exchange Commission

item.title: Anthropic raises $65B Series H at $965B valuation
item.description: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital.

item.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
item.description: Claude Opus 4.8 brings stronger performance across coding, agentic tasks, and professional work, and the consistency to handle long-running work.
